title: SWE-Clar: Can Coding Agents Clarify Incomplete Client Requirements and Deliver Greenfield Software?
abstract: arXiv:2610.31854v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Greenfield software development in freelance settings requires coding agents to turn incomplete client requests into working software. This makes requirement clarification essential, yet clients may be unable to provide continuous feedback over long development cycles, and receiving their answers does not guarantee correct understanding of complex requirements. These challenges motivate two benchmark design choices: clarification precedes code implementation, and its effectiveness is assessed through explicit tests of requirement understanding. Guided by these choices, we introduce SWE-Clar, a benchmark grounded in real, high-value client commissions to evaluate requirement clarification and code implementation in this setting. It comprises 100 tasks based on real software development jobs on Upwork, each with at least US\$4,000 in total payments. translated_title: SWE-Clar：编码智能体能否澄清不完整的客户需求并交付全新软件？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.31854v1 公告类型：交叉引用（cross）。摘要：在自由职业环境中，全新软件开发要求编码智能体将不完整的客户请求转化为可运行的软件。这使得需求澄清至关重要，然而客户可能无法在漫长的开发周期中提供持续反馈，而且即使收到客户的回答，也不能保证智能体能正确理解复杂需求。这些挑战促成了两项基准设计选择：需求澄清先于代码实现，并通过明确的需求理解测试来评估澄清的有效性。基于这些设计选择，我们提出了 SWE-Clar，这是一个基于真实、高价值客户委托的基准，用于评估该场景下的需求澄清与代码实现能力。该基准包含 100 个源自 Upwork 上真实软件开发工作的任务，每个任务的总报酬至少为 4,000 美元。每个任务均以编码智能体与客户智能体之间的多轮交互开始，
tldr: 该论文提出了 SWE-Clar 基准，基于 100 个报酬至少 4,000 美元的真实 Upwork 客户委托任务，通过“先澄清需求、后实现代码”的多轮交互设计并以明确的需求理解测试来评估编码智能体在自由职业全新软件开发中澄清不完整客户需求的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SWE-Clar, a benchmark of 100 real Upwork commissions (each worth at least US$4,000) that evaluates whether coding agents can clarify incomplete client requirements—via clarification-first, multi-round interactions with explicit requirement-understanding tests—before delivering greenfield software.
